title: Picking the Right Database
unclear_source_points: The source says to prefer a relational database when strong consistency is needed, but it does not define the operation, consistency model, transaction boundary, or deployment assumptions.

The source groups MongoDB with key-value stores in one branch and recommends a document database as a future-proof fallback; the exact intended boundary between key-value and document workloads is not stated.

The source explains relational scale-out by relaxing relations and constraints, avoiding cross-shard transactions, and sharding manually, but does not specify which guarantees may safely move to the application.
The automatic transcript repeatedly mistranscribes Redis and Neo4j; the intended product names were resolved against the supplied slides and video.

ranges_checked: the final video segment from 00:09:53 through 00:12:21.261

tasks.summary: Explore familiar databases and test how one database type can serve a workload usually associated with another type.
